## findings

- **T1-F1 SOURCE-FACTOR RED — the relief computation has no honest method factor.** Symptom: the only `method` factor of taxacct_ext_penalty_relief_request, `paper_filing_relief_factor`, selects 0.75 / 0.9 / 1 inside the same product. Root cause: mislabelled effect (`_difficulty.md` F-1). Evidence: rule "a report filed on paper by an employer that filed at least two original reports through the online portal within the portal lookback months is multiplied by the two-filing paper factor ... any other report is not multiplied"; compute `result: RND(penalty_paid * history_share * estimate_share * payment_share * cooperation_share * timing_share * paper_relief_factor, 2)`. Demonstrated consequence: on this world the factor acts exactly like the history share (both 0.75; substituting either baseline gives the same 98.40), i.e. a number in one formula; computations[1] has 0 honest method factors (bound >= 1). Affected: charter factors[paper_filing_relief_factor].effect; `tasks/1.json` computations[1].factor_trace[5], design_rationale factor counts.
- **T1-F2 SOURCE-FACTOR RED — the late-penalty computation's repeat_multiplier is mislabelled.** Evidence: rule "multiplied by the two-penalty repeat multiplier ... exactly one is multiplied by the one-penalty repeat multiplier, and an account with none is not multiplied"; compute `MN(penalty_cap, wage_share_amount * repeat_multiplier)` with 2.0 / 1.5 / 1. Consequence: computations[0] keeps its one required method only through repeat_lookback_length, itself a borderline label (window lengths 12 / 34 / 24 fed into one COUNT; _difficulty.md O-11); the declared "4 parameter + 2 method" is false. Affected: charter factors[repeat_multiplier].effect; `tasks/1.json` computations[0].factor_trace[2].
- **T1-F3 SOURCE-FACTOR RED — request_timing_share rests on an unreal condition.** Symptom: relief is cut to 0.95 because the request is made on day 20 instead of day 10 of a 30-day abatement window. Root cause: `_difficulty.md` F-3 — an agency treats the request period as a pass/fail deadline (the inherited base sentence: "a request on the last day is in time"); it does not grade relief by how early a timely request came. Demonstrated consequence: the gold 73.80 includes this tier; without it the figure is 77.68. Affected: charter taxacct_ext_penalty_relief_request rule sentence "The timing share follows the calendar days from the penalty assessment date to the day of the request ..." and factors[request_timing_share]; `tasks/1.json` computations[1].
- Observations: `_difficulty.md` O-12 (cooperation share realism) bears on this figure; O-5 (`within_months: 34` in the charter's inputs block matches this account's window).

#### findings (revision 2)

- **T1-R2-F1 SOURCE-FACTOR RED — the relief computation still has no honest method factor.** Symptom: the only factor labelled `method` in taxacct_ext_penalty_relief_request, `relief_lookback_length`, selects one of three constants for the history-share window. Root cause: `_difficulty.md` §revision_2 R2-F1. Evidence: rule "an account in delinquent status looks back over the delinquent lookback months, an account in active status with no late payment interest entry booked within the payment record months looks back over the clean record lookback months, and any other account looks back over the class's penalty abatement lookback quarters, counted as three months each"; params `delinquent_lookback_months: 36`, `clean_record_lookback_months: 12`; compute `COUNT('employer_tax_ledger', within_months=relief_lookback_months, ...)`. Demonstrated consequence on this world: the factor acts only as a number does — 36 months admits `37447716` (2024-08-20) and gives 51.79, 24 months excludes it and gives 77.68, in one unchanged formula; honest counts for computations[1] are 6 parameter / 0 method (bound >= 1). Contrast with the accepted borderline repeat_lookback_length: its whole-liability tier derives the window from the account's registration date (count every penalty since registration) rather than picking a constant; relief_lookback_length has no such tier. The coordinator may weigh this line; the auditor's verdict is RED. Affected: `taxacct.extended.yaml` taxacct_ext_penalty_relief_request.factors[relief_lookback_length].effect (and the absence of any genuine method tier in that policy); `tasks/1.json` design_rationale "relief: 5 parameter + 1 method". Relation to previous revision: continuation of T1-F1 (round 1) in a new factor.
- Observations: none new for this world (R2-O2, R2-O3 do not touch the relief tree).
